name: runner-without-the-repo
about: #467: an item is on a repo (sandbox/extra) loopd knows but the only runner has no checkout of. The runner's claims name its repos, so it is not given the item: no claim, no run failing with 'no repo configured', the item waits in build. Once the hand runner that triaged it has not been seen for a day, loopd flags it unservable, naming the repo. When runner.json gains the repo (a reload, as on SIGHUP), the flag clears and the runner claims and builds it.

steps.text:
sandbox/extra: pantry
sandbox/jarvis-node-mobile: mobile, node app
